mapper.select: SELECT id,knowledge_title title, LEFT(knowledge_content,500) content,feature_module,issue_type,effectiveness_score,knowledge_source, source_rca_id,supersedes_knowledge_id supersedes_id,lifecycle_version,published_at,expires_at, CONCAT('KNOWLEDGE:',id) trace_reference, CASE WHEN #{issue}<>'' AND issue_type=#{issue} THEN '问题类型匹配' ELSE '功能模块匹配' END match_reason FROM t_ai_knowledge WHERE knowledge_status='PUBLISHED' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>NOW(3)) AND ((#{issue}<>'' AND issue_type=#{issue}) OR (#{module}<>'' AND feature_module=#{module})) ORDER BY (issue_type=#{issue}) DESC,effectiveness_score IS NULL,effectiveness_score DESC,published_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
